rules.rule: Council official style; parish/community: village, town council: town, city only official city list; level one below current district/council; unit-only identities are separate.

ONS workbook Minor -> village / built-up area, every other published size class -> town / built-up area; city register overrides. NRS locality -> section / locality. NISRA raw SDL Band A-E town / settlement, F-H village / settlement. Direct administrative depth plus one; subdivisions add statistical parent tier.
Council-style and identity review continued; no novel class.
Council-style and identity review continued; no novel class.
S19 locality level 3: Scotland 1 > council area 2 > locality 3. Retain type; never infer village from S19.

rule_provenance.owner_decision: 18 Nov owner rule, applied by work_tld2 brief: own items combining settlement and civil parish/community stay as parish/community; use their own code and 2021 parish/community count regardless of old figure gap. Council style must be officially proved.
rule_provenance.subdivisions: 2011 BUASD product held: no 2022 subdivision equivalence claimed
rule_provenance.population: Code-bound uses the published count regardless of old/new ratio. Name-bound counts only when symmetric old/new ratio <=1.5. Keep both counts in ledger otherwise.

licence: ONS/NRS/NISRA OGL v3; Wikidata CC0; council name/style facts from official council sites
method: Retain 265 settlement decisions and all 654 original holds. Amend only 167 dual own items. Select exactly one own E04/W04 code valid on 21 March 2021 using ONS RGC operation/termination dates. Strict stored-point containment, unique code/item owner, official council style and original depth rule required. ONS/Nomis PP002 own parish/community count and 2021 only; any failed step holds entire row; no BUA fallback.
